title: Set aside (different measures): A little screen time and children's well-being: no difference, or slightly better?
explanation: Claim A asserts that there is no difference in psychological well-being between non-users and low users, whereas Claim B asserts that light users have higher psychological well-being than non-users.
a_text: Non-users and low users (1 hour per day) of screens generally do not differ in psychological well-being.
b_text: Light users of digital media exhibit slightly higher psychological well-being than non-users.
